description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Wind with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Wind Mode I (Zack v2)] and [Wind Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Wind Mode I (Zack v2)
description.text: Wind abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Wind abilities trigger 2 additional times, attacks deal 5%/10%/15%/20% additional critical damage for equipped Wind abilities after casting 1/2/3/4+ Wind abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Wind Mode II (Zack v2)] to the user

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Wind Mode II (Zack v2)
description.text: Cast speed x999999, grants [Buff Wind 20% (15s)] to all allies and [Quick Cast 2] to the user after using Wind abilities

description.name: Buff Wind 20% (15s)
description.text: Increases Wind damage dealt by 20%, cumulable

description.name: Attach Wind with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3
